title: Independent semantic, source and composition check of remaining ordinary-prose candidates
status: Read-only data review; no source changes or fluency approval.
auditMethod: Compared all nine candidate source spans and four held predicates with the current paired JSONs and learner draft modules at the stated HEAD. Checked exact source indices, target prefixes/suffixes, modals/comparatives, list preservation, wind scope and trailing separator. Pair JSON segment arrays were checked at the exact slide/body/segment index; code-module body strings and exact held technical predicates were corroborated. Curly versus ASCII apostrophes in the two source representations were treated as punctuation variants, not as scope changes.

overallNotes: Direct-sowing candidates replace only “They do better” and preserve the direct-sowing condition and crop-list sentence; “perform/work better” keeps general performance, not growth-only.

ST pest candidate keeps the localized Only-then/action prefix and does not absorb the following physical-removal/barrier/crop-care list or treatment instructions. VE and TS pest predicates remain HOLD because their words may mean easiest/softest instead of least-intensive while effective.
Direct-selling candidate keeps “can”, a larger retained share of sale money, and every stated trade-off: time, packing, transport, customer care.

Waterworks candidates retain any/every applicability and site suitability, with preceding Choose/Nangani and following safe-route clause each preserved once. Sesotho “water-related work” terminology merits local check; Tshivenda retains “water works.”
VE wind proposal retains direction, strength, damaging wind, region, season and site ridges/gaps. It preserves the trailing ASCII space.
All four technical held predicates remain exact English; no new meaning was inferred.
limits: No external research or language authority was used.
ACCEPT is source-scope/meaning only, never fluent/local farmer approval.
HOLD means preserve source English pending resolution of the noted exact meaning.
